scope: Focused semantic cross-check of five zero-finding live shards; not a second full audit. Screened exact candidate task text/context against frozen 818841 ROOT snapshot and APP 07b352d0 JEV source. No canonical writes.

classification_corrections.reason: The task explicitly tests a simulated new model with known feature values; this is a synthetic cold-start convergence fixture and needs no live model call. Keep deployment/new-model generalization outside this fixture result.

DAR-5.2 is an implementation/replacement of a feature vector with a learned identity embedding, conditional on DAR-4. Source does not require live inference for code/schema/fixture preparation. The eventual training/reward comparison remains conditional on the separately stated fixed reward and measured-data gates.

URE-2 is a trace-schema/write-path deliverable with specified fields. Recording an approval boundary does not itself authorize an action. Implement/schema-fixture work is independent; any actual approval remains represented as an actor field and governed by host policy.

URE-2a explicitly describes a non-authoritative local cascade shadow that continues returning incumbent output; it requires live calls on a later frozen traffic window after CJ-16 fixture quality/operations acceptance. URE-1 calibration gates authority/promotion, and the text says it does not block measurement-only shadow. Keep normal resource/window gate, but do not misstate the task as awaiting operator approval.

UTM-B1 states the read surface is already built and names the missing pieces exactly: MCP registration and orchestrator wiring. Registration/contract fixtures are source/code preparation, not inference. For schema reuse, JEV tool_args only handles closed enums, booleans, bounded integer ranges and enum arrays; it explicitly skips other/free-text shapes, so do not force arbitrary search strings through it.
UTM-B4 explicitly says the Tulving adapter routing is zero compute to write. Keep actual retrieval evaluation under its existing compute gate; the adapter/wiring slice can be prepared independently.

The task itself separates deterministic prerequisite fixes (non-destructive replay DB mode/merge, stable corpus↔live ids, turn-alignment path) from running replay, which explicitly needs inference. The review should preserve those offline adapter/fixture steps instead of making the whole task inert or treating them as satisfying real-data pairing.

missed_jev_refinement.title: UTM-V3 semantic-verifier fixture and receipt discipline can reuse the existing isolated judge harness pattern
missed_jev_refinement.original_contract: Keep deterministic structural checks separate from a versioned semantic judge; build human-labeled adversarial cases and report false-pass/false-fail by class. Do not inherit the external VerMem paper result.
missed_jev_refinement.proposed_bounded_refinement: Before any live semantic judging, prepare the human-labeled case manifest and deterministic mock-primitive/parser fixtures using the existing judge_redundancy receipt pattern: frozen case/rubric hashes, explicit per-criterion outputs, parse/transport failure as unresolved, and separate agreement from accuracy against human gold. Reuse existing Question/DecisionResult where an output is truly a closed choice; preserve arbitrary memory-operation explanation/payload as source data. No new grading ladder, no import of CJ-13 synthetic ground truth, no semantic-validity claim from reader agreement, and no live judge call required for this preparation.

toolkit_reuse.what: Demonstrates frozen hashed evaluator cases, strict output parsing, unresolved failures, and a structural distinction between accuracy against known ground truth and reader-reader agreement. Reuse fixture/receipt mechanics only; UTM’s human-labeled cases remain its own ground truth.

Typed choices can capture a genuinely closed decision; parse/schema failure is carried explicitly rather than defaulted. Not suitable as a substitute for arbitrary semantic rationale or host-side structural validation.

source_evidence.observation: UTM-V3 explicitly separates deterministic structural verification from a semantic judge and requires human labels/adversarial classes.
Existing isolated grader scaffold hashes frozen cases and distinguishes accuracy from agreement; malformed or unresolved emissions do not become verdicts.
Typed runner returns per-question ParseFailure and does not silently default missing decisions.

missed_jev_refinement.ownership: UTM handoff owner; proposal only for owner/main review. No APP code changes or ROOT edits made.
missed_jev_refinement.confidence_limits: This is a test/evidence-shape reuse recommendation, not evidence that CJ-13 graders work for memory semantics. The UTM human label set and semantic rubric require their own authoring/adjudication.

explicit_no_append_decisions.reason: Already requires human-graded validation for faithfulness and rejects agreement-only validation. Existing JEV synthetic rubric truth is not a substitute for human labels on fleet traces; no new grader/ladder should be added.

This is a host PreToolUse allowlist that blocks unauthorized actions. PreparedAction/DecisionResult cannot grant command authority; preserve deterministic host enforcement and fail-closed unknown commands.

It estimates independent observed correctness rates per admissible role and explicitly separates rates from softmax confidence. Do not coerce it into a single JEV confidence/choice; preserve unsupported and incumbent fallback behavior.

Only bounded closed operation enums might map through tool_args; arbitrary operation payloads are unsupported and must remain structural host-validated data. No evidence justifies a blanket JEV rewrite.
